evidence.quote: When FTX took a loss in the hundreds of million dollars because a trader had exploited its system, Wang moved that loss onto Alameda’s balance sheet.
Alameda also allegedly kept FTX from looking bad by assuming some of its losses.
Bankman-Fried directed him to have Alameda take it on instead, because FTX’s balance sheets were visible to investors and Alameda’s weren’t.
Alameda could have negative balances and unlimited withdrawals.
